baseline.tests: Three new parser regressions applied to the baseline implementation
baseline.command: rustup run 1.99.1 cargo test -p ax-engine-core --lib grammar::json::tests -- --nocapture

candidate.command: rustup run 1.99.1 cargo test -p ax-engine-core --lib grammar:: -- --nocapture

findings: Repeated declared object keys used the unconstrained additional-property schema on their second occurrence.
A property-name byte cursor saturated at 65535, losing declared schema identity for longer names.
A literal byte cursor overflowed at 65535, panicking in debug builds and wrapping in release builds.
fixes: Repeated declared names retain their declared value schema; unknown names still use additionalProperties.
String-backed byte cursors use usize; unknown key prefixes drop irrelevant length state.
m5_scope: Normal, nested Unicode, reasoning, insufficient token budget, greedy and sampled open-object JSON. Boundary failures are reproduced by synthetic parser tests; the model run is an integration smoke.
